description: Holds branch review dealer performance records, linked to branch review header.
business_purpose: Used to track and report branch review dealer performance records, including amounts and quantities, for the Sales Planning & Performance area.
record_granularity: One row represents one branch review dealer performance.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the branch review dealer performance.

columns.name: header_id
columns.description: Reference to the branch review header linked to this branch review dealer performance.

columns.name: monthly_planner
columns.description: Monthly planner of the branch review dealer performance.

columns.name: dispatched
columns.description: Dispatched of the branch review dealer performance.

columns.name: pending_cleared
columns.description: Pending cleared of the branch review dealer performance.

columns.name: pending_uncleared
columns.description: Pending uncleared of the branch review dealer performance.

columns.name: balance
columns.description: Balance of the branch review dealer performance.

columns.name: section_type
columns.description: Section type of the branch review dealer performance.

relationships.description: Each branch review dealer performance references one branch review header (header).

business_rules: Use dispatched / pending_cleared for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns section_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Join to Branch Review Header through the foreign key columns to resolve names.

common_metrics.name: Average Dispatched per branch review dealer performance

common_queries: Branch Review Dealer Performance by branch review header
Branch Review Dealer Performance count by section type
Top branch review header by dispatched

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name BranchReviewDealerPerformance (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use COUNT(DISTINCT Id) when counting branch review dealer performance records; joins can duplicate rows.
Use SUM(dispatched) for totals of dispatched.
To resolve names, join on: header_id = BranchReviewHeader.Id.
